summary: Scalar measurement within a known range (role="meter"): used storage, quotas, capacity, password strength. Optional thresholds change the tone.
whenToUse: Values that represent a level, not the progress of a task.
whenNotToUse: Loading or tasks in progress: use Progress or CircularProgress.
Values without a meaningful minimum/maximum: use Statistic.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Value text (e.g. “7.2 GB / 10 GB”), also used for aria-valuetext.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Value formatting based on the locale.

props.name: tone
props.description: Fixed tone; when omitted it is computed from the thresholds (or brand).

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Ascending inclusive thresholds; below them the tone is success.

accessibility: role="meter" with aria-valuenow/min/max and a localized aria-valuetext.
Tone is only a visual aid: also convey the meaning in text (valueLabel, description).
In forced-colors mode the bar uses system colors.
responsive: Fills the container width; label and value wrap with long text.
commonMistakes: Relying on color alone to convey “full/almost full”.
Thresholds for decreasing values (e.g. battery): set tone explicitly.
limits: Thresholds assume that higher values are worse.
